title: Lean formalization
headline: Lean 4, 0 sorry, standard axioms: four laws of biology (Kimura k = mu via the proved fixation probability, Fisher FTNS, Maynard Smith twofold cost, Thompson's cube law) and two extensions (fixation >= i/M when selection does not oppose a mutant; well-formedness of a generated anatomical blueprint). 38 theorems, 51 lemmas; 13 of 13 statement or data mutants rejected, 7/7 controls. NEW: a kernel-checked certificate for the organism thread's flying-fish blueprint: 536 distinct terms, 674 part_of edges, acyclic, every term reaches the body root, 1390 never_in_taxon and 5435 in_taxon statements pinned from Ubergraph exclude nothing, distinct counts per level body 1, organ_system 13, organ 67, tissue 198, cell 257 (the placement-vs-term count the organism thread fixed by hand). Structural only: it does not say the fish is real or the ontology right. Thompson's cube law has a formal statement (exact exponent 3) beside the claims thread's measured exponents (2.74-2.86 on age-bin means; 2.10 to 3.10 by age window). Flying-fish substitution budget still inconclusive. 21 unsigned nanopub drafts pass np check + parse + Delphi lint; no human named; nothing signed or published.
